confidence_notes: Food anchors are supported by Byron-specific cost-of-living data last updated in October 2025, an April 2026 coffee sample and a local bar menu; the survey has few contributors and the bar menu may skew upscale. Accommodation is a holistic estimate with strong seasonal uncertainty; no current lodging listings were inspected.
comparable_city_reasoning: Byron Bay's food and drink reflect local observations; accommodation is estimated from general knowledge of high-demand coastal tourist towns in eastern Australia.
